Why you should choose a "Modern Classic" as your daily driver

It’s no secret that modern classics – cars from the late ’80s to the early 2000s – have been on the rise. Values are climbing, demand is growing, and enthusiasts around the world are realizing something that’s been true all along: these cars aren’t just collectibles – they can make fantastic daily drivers. 

Many people hesitate to use a modern classic every day. The reputation says they’re expensive to own, unreliable, and thirsty. But in reality, the opposite is often true. A well-chosen car – like our Toyota Century – can handle daily life with ease, while offering more character, comfort, and soul than most brand-new models.

Take this particular Century, for example. It’s over 25 years old and has covered more than 150,000 kilometers – 50,000 of those with us behind the wheel. And yet, it recently passed its annual inspection with flying colors – something many new cars struggle to do. Aside from regular servicing, a brake booster, and a new set of tires, it’s been completely trouble-free. In fact, it’s the most reliable car we’ve ever owned, regardless of age. 

Sure, it drinks a bit more fuel than today’s hybrids or EVs. But when you factor in low maintenance costs, inexpensive parts, and zero depreciation, the math quickly adds up. Combine that with the feel, sound, and design that only older cars can offer, and you get a machine that turns every commute into something to look forward to.

So put it in short, here's some of the reasons why you should choose a modern classic as your daily driver:

  • Low maintenance costs - You can service your car at almost any workshop, or do it yourself
  • Inexpensive parts - Depends on model but in general parts for a 90's car is a lot cheaper than an -25 model EV
  • Low or zero depreciation in value - Most modern classics are now instead getting more expensive
  • The feeling of driving - Can't be pointed out enough

Find your next daily driver now!

With the right modern classic, you don’t just get economy and emotion in one package – you get an experience.
It’s not only a smart buy; it’s a fun one. 

So if, like us, you dream of driving something with real character every day – check out our selection of modern classics on Bidders Highway and find your next daily driver with soul.
